points.label: Pajtueshmëria Etike / Ethical compliance
points.anchor: v1.0 R1.2 (individual: host's on-air conduct), lower-of-two rule R1.2-S + R1.2-P
points.bandDerivation: R1.2-S points to 41–60: no published TV Klan corrections policy or KShM commitment found; no KShM/AME decision; AMA attributed lack of distancing from guests to the host (Complaints Council, Bulletin 17, Opinion 04.11.2024, T1) and a 30.10.2026 fine on TV Klan over the 22.10.2026 Opinion (Directorate act, Board confirmation not found) — not counted as a confirmed serious breach. R1.2-P: unmarked opinion-as-fact in 5.6% of host factual segments (<10%, which alone would fit 61–80) but corrections only ad hoc (one live self-correction) without a stated policy = the 41–60 descriptor. Lower of the two = 41–60. Robust to sampling error: even the upper CI bound (12.5%) stays inside 41–60.
